"""Ordinary MIDI SDS boundary probe with read-only observation."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse,hashlib,json,time,struct
from PIL import Image
from probe_base import ObservedRuntime,ROOT,HERE
from s760_runtime import RuntimeConfig

ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
ap.add_argument('--system',type=Path,default=ROOT/'roms/System/S760224.IMG')
ap.add_argument('--scenario',default='interactive')
ap.add_argument('--drain',action='store_true');ap.add_argument('--cancel-delay',type=float,default=1.0)
ap.add_argument('--lengths',default='41');ap.add_argument('--device',type=int,default=0)
ap.add_argument('--interactive-before',action='store_true')
a=ap.parse_args();work=a.output.resolve();work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
cfg=RuntimeConfig(ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN',a.system.resolve(),work/'runtime',sound=False,throttle=False,wave_dump=work/'wave.bin')
inputs=[cfg.executable,cfg.boot_rom,cfg.system_disk,ROOT/'S760224.IMG',Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',HERE/'probe_base.py']
hashes={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs}
events=[]
def packed(n):return [n&127,(n>>7)&127,(n>>14)&127]
def header(slot,n):return [240,126,a.device,1,slot&127,slot>>7,16,*packed(22675),*packed(n),*packed(0),*packed(n-1),127,247]
def packet(number,values):
 data=[]
 for value in values:
  unsigned=(value&65535)^32768;data.extend([unsigned>>9,(unsigned>>2)&127,(unsigned&3)<<5])
 body=[126,a.device,2,number&127,*data];checksum=0
 for byte in body:checksum^=byte
 return [240,*body,checksum,247]
with ObservedRuntime(cfg) as rt:
 def wait(seconds):
  end=rt.request('status')[0]['seconds']+seconds;deadline=time.monotonic()+120
  while rt.request('status')[0]['seconds']<end:
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline
   time.sleep(.005)
 def shot(name):
  rt.request('pause');frames=rt.request('frames');Image.frombytes('RGBA',(640,480),frames[1][0][6:]).save(work/(name+'.png'))
  ram=(rt.observation_folder/f'frame-{rt.snapshot_count:02}.ram').read_bytes()
  context=json.loads((rt.observation_folder/f'frame-{rt.snapshot_count:02}.json').read_text());lo=context['selectors']['0108']<<10
  row=dict(name=name,snapshot=rt.snapshot_count,seconds=context['seconds'],state=ram[lo+0x2bba],cursor=struct.unpack_from('<H',ram,lo+0x3616)[0],descriptor=ram[0xd2800:0xd2830].hex(),transfer=ram[0xb2980:0xb29b0].hex())
  events.append(row);print(json.dumps(row),flush=True);rt.request('resume')
 def send(raw):
  rt.request('midi',bytes=raw);events.append(dict(midi=raw,seconds=rt.request('status')[0]['seconds']))
 def button(port,name):
  rt.request('button',port=port,name=name,down=True);wait(.12)
  rt.request('button',port=port,name=name,down=False);wait(.25)
 def click(x,y):
  rt.request('pointer',x=x,y=y);wait(.25);button(':NATIVE_MOUSE_BUTTONS','Mouse Left')
 wait(20);shot('boot')
 if not a.interactive_before:
  click(142,5);click(100,38);rt.request('pointer',x=141,y=50);wait(.3);rt.request('dial',id='ALPHA',delta=1);wait(1);shot('exclusive-enabled')
  click(10,5);click(15,22);wait(1);shot('perform-enabled')
 if a.interactive_before:
  rt.request('pause');request_id=0;ready=False;deadline=time.monotonic()+1200
  while not ready:
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline
   path=work/f'command-{request_id:03}.json'
   if not path.exists():time.sleep(.05);continue
   for command in json.loads(path.read_text()):
    events.append(dict(command=command));op=command['op'];rt.request('resume')
    if op=='click':click(command['x'],command['y'])
    elif op=='shot':shot(command['name'])
    elif op=='dial':rt.request('pointer',x=command['x'],y=command['y']);wait(.3);rt.request('dial',id='ALPHA',delta=command['delta']);wait(1)
    elif op=='continue':ready=True
    else:raise ValueError(op)
    rt.request('pause')
   request_id+=1
  rt.request('resume')
 def values(slot,number):return [((i+number*40+slot*17)%251-125)*128 for i in range(40)]
 def complete(slot,n):
  for number in range((n+39)//40):send(packet(number,values(slot,number)));wait(.15)
  wait(1);shot(f'complete-{slot}')
 send(header(0,41));wait(.7);shot('seed-header');complete(0,41)
 send(header(1,41));wait(.7);complete(1,41)
 rt.request('pause');request_id=0;ready=False;deadline=time.monotonic()+1800
 while not ready:
  assert time.monotonic()<deadline
  path=work/f'command-{request_id:03}.json'
  if not path.exists():time.sleep(.05);continue
  commands=json.loads(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
  for command in commands:
   events.append(dict(command=command));op=command['op'];rt.request('resume')
   if op=='click':click(command['x'],command['y'])
   elif op=='shot':shot(command['name'])
   elif op=='wait':wait(command['seconds'])
   elif op=='midi':send(command['bytes']);wait(command.get('wait',.2))
   elif op=='button':button(command.get('port',':PANEL1'),command['name'])
   elif op=='dial':rt.request('pointer',x=command['x'],y=command['y']);wait(.3);rt.request('dial',id='ALPHA',delta=command['delta']);wait(1)
   elif op=='continue':ready=True
   else:raise ValueError(op)
   rt.request('pause')
  request_id+=1
 rt.request('resume')
 send(header(3,41));wait(.7);shot('follow-on-header');complete(3,41)
 wait(1);shot('final')
assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==hashes[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in inputs)
(work/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(events=events,identities=hashes,source_unchanged=True),indent=2)+'\n')

"""Replay ordinary native UI/MIDI cases; no direct guest mutation."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,subprocess,sys,time

HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;ROOT=HERE.parents[3]
def shot(name):return dict(op='shot',name=name)
def wait(seconds):return dict(op='wait',seconds=seconds)
def midi(command,number=0):return dict(op='midi',bytes=[240,126,0,command,number&127,247],wait=.12)
entry=[dict(op='click',x=142,y=5),dict(op='click',x=100,y=38),shot('midi-screen'),dict(op='click',x=44,y=98),shot('local-header')]
finish=[wait(3),shot('local-exit'),dict(op='click',x=10,y=5),dict(op='click',x=15,y=22),shot('perform-return'),dict(op='continue')]
cases={
 'final-open-complete':entry+[wait(30)]+finish,
 'final-open-cancel':entry+[wait(3),shot('local-data'),dict(op='button',name='Exit')]+finish,
 'final-ack-complete':entry+[midi(127),shot('local-data')]+[midi(127,n) for n in range(115)]+finish,
 'final-ack-cancel':entry+[midi(127),shot('local-data'),dict(op='button',name='Exit')]+finish,
 'final-remote-stall':[
     dict(op='midi',bytes=[240,126,0,3,0,0,247]),shot('remote-header'),wait(60),shot('remote-stalled'),
     dict(op='button',name='Exit'),wait(2),shot('remote-exit-key'),midi(125),shot('remote-midi-cancel'),
     dict(op='continue')],
}
for name in sys.argv[1:] or list(cases):
    output=HERE/name
    with (HERE/(name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
        proc=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B',str(HERE/'native_local.py'),'--system',str(HERE/'S760224.SDS-LOCAL.IMG'),'--output',str(output)],cwd=ROOT,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
        try:
            deadline=time.monotonic()+30
            while not output.exists():
                assert proc.poll() is None and time.monotonic()<deadline
                time.sleep(.05)
            temp=output/'command.tmp';temp.write_text(json.dumps(cases[name]),encoding='utf-8');temp.replace(output/'command-000.json')
            assert proc.wait(timeout=240)==0,name
        finally:
            if proc.poll() is None:proc.terminate();proc.wait(timeout=10)
    print(name+' completed',flush=True)

"""Run existing native acceptance workflows with read-only BS1 observations."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import runpy
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
import s760_runtime

class ObservedRuntime(s760_runtime.NativeRuntime):
    def _start(self,timeout):
        folder=self.config.state_dir.resolve()/'bs1-observer'
        folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
        wrapper=folder/'wrapper.lua'
        observer=folder/'observer.lua'
        shutil.copyfile(HERE/'observer.lua',observer)
        wrapper.write_text('dofile('+json.dumps((ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua').as_posix())+')\n'
                           +'dofile('+json.dumps(observer.as_posix())+')\n',encoding='utf-8')
        launch=subprocess.Popen
        def observed(command,**kwargs):
            command=list(command)
            command[command.index('-autoboot_script')+1]=str(wrapper)
            kwargs['env']['BS1_OBSERVER_DIR']=folder.as_posix()
            return launch([*command,'-log'],**kwargs)
        self.observation_folder=folder
        self.snapshot_count=0
        with patch('s760_runtime.subprocess.Popen',side_effect=observed):
            super()._start(timeout)

    def request(self,operation,**kwargs):
        result=super().request(operation,**kwargs)
        if operation=='frames':
            self.snapshot_count+=1
            tag=f'frame-{self.snapshot_count:02}'
            temporary=self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.tmp'
            temporary.write_text(tag,encoding='ascii')
            temporary.replace(self.observation_folder/'snapshot-request.txt')
            deadline=time.monotonic()+10
            while not (self.observation_folder/(tag+'.json')).exists():
                if self.process.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError('Observer process stopped')
                if time.monotonic()>deadline:raise TimeoutError('Read-only snapshot timed out')
                time.sleep(.02)
        return result

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--workflow',choices=('stereo','scsi-save'),required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True)
    args=parser.parse_args()
    workflow=ROOT/'scripts'/('verify_native_sampling_input.py' if args.workflow=='stereo' else 'verify_native_scsi_save.py')
    files=[Path(__file__),HERE/'observer.lua',workflow,ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.py',ROOT/'scripts/s760_runtime.lua',ROOT/'mame-source/mames760.exe',ROOT/'S760224.IMG',ROOT/'roms/BOOT/Roland_S-760_v1.11.BIN']
    identity={str(p.relative_to(ROOT)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in files}
    sys.argv=[str(workflow),'--state-dir',str(args.output.resolve())]
    if args.workflow=='stereo':
        sys.argv+=['--blank-disk',str(ROOT/'docs/ic20-hle-findings/chatGPT-work/media-verification-20261012-065549/formatted.img')]
    with patch.object(s760_runtime,'NativeRuntime',ObservedRuntime):
        runpy.run_path(str(workflow),run_name='__main__')
    assert all(hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==identity[str(p.relative_to(ROOT))] for p in files), 'Input changed during observation'
    (args.output/'observer-identities.json').write_text(json.dumps(identity,indent=2)+'\n')

if __name__=='__main__':main()

def digest(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def sha(p):return digest(p.read_bytes())
def u16(b,o):return struct.unpack_from('<H',b,o)[0]
def u32(b,o):return struct.unpack_from('<I',b,o)[0]
def table(r):return r[0xD2800:0xD8800]
def messages(raw):
    parts=raw.split(b'\xf7');assert parts[-1]==b''
    rows=[p+b'\xf7' for p in parts[:-1]]
    assert all(m[:3]==bytes([240,126,0]) for m in rows)
    return rows
def pcm(m):
    assert len(m)==127 and m[3]==2
    checksum=0
    for byte in m[1:-1]:checksum^=byte
    assert checksum==0
    return struct.pack('<40H',*[((m[i]<<9)|(m[i+1]<<2)|(m[i+2]>>5))^32768 for i in range(5,125,3)])

    body=[126,0,2,n&127]
    for o in range(n*80,min(n*80+80,len(source)),2):
        value=u16(source,o)^32768;body.extend([value>>9,(value>>2)&127,(value&3)<<5])
    body.extend([0]*(124-len(body)));check=0
    for b in body:check^=b
    return bytes([240,*body,check,247])
ack=lambda n:bytes([240,126,0,127,n,247])
cancel=lambda n:bytes([240,126,0,125,n&127,247])
common=[ack(127),ack(0),ack(1)]
header=bytes([240,126,0,1,0,0,16,20,49,1,0,36,0,1,0,0,39,0,0,127,247])

runs={};snapshots=[];samples=[];complete_sends=[]
for name in names:
    folder=HERE/name;result=json.loads((folder/'result.json').read_text());assert result['source_unchanged']
    assert all(sha(ROOT/p)==h for p,h in result['identities'].items())
    image=next(ROOT/p for p in result['identities'] if 'S760224.SDS-' in p).read_bytes()
    events=result['events'];shots={e['name']:e for e in events if 'snapshot'in e};frames={}
    for tag,e in shots.items():
        f=folder/f'runtime/bs1-observer/frame-{e["snapshot"]:02}'
        r=f.with_suffix('.ram').read_bytes();w=f.with_suffix('.wave').read_bytes();c=json.loads(f.with_suffix('.json').read_text())
        assert len(r)==0x100000 and len(w)==0x80000
        assert r[0x83BBA]==e['state'] and u16(r,0x84616)==u16(r,0xA739E)==e['cursor']
        for patch in manifest['patches']:

        frames[tag]=(r,w,c)

    assert replies==expected,name

        assert b''.join(pcm(m) for m in data)[:9216]==source
        complete_sends.append(dict(run=name,exact_pcm_bytes=9216,pcm_sha256=digest(source),packets=116))
    extra={}
    if name=='v2-remote-stall':
        before=frames['remote-header'][0]
        for tag in ('remote-stalled','remote-exit-key'):
            r=frames[tag][0];assert r[0xB29AE]==1 and r[0xB2980:0xB29B0]==before[0xB2980:0xB29B0]
        elapsed=shots['remote-stalled']['seconds']-shots['remote-header']['seconds'];assert elapsed>=60
        assert frames['remote-midi-cancel'][0][0xB29AE]==255
        extra=dict(observed_no_progress_seconds=elapsed,panel_exit_releases=False,midi_cancel_releases=True)
    runs[name]=dict(accepted=positive,identities=result['identities'],events=events,tx_messages=wire,
                   ownership=[json.loads(s) for s in (folder/'runtime/bs1-observer/ownership.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()],
                   result_sha256=sha(folder/'result.json'),log_sha256=sha(folder/'runtime/error.log'),
                   ack_count=sum(m[3]==127 for m in replies),cancel_count=sum(m[3]==125 for m in replies),data_packets=len(data),**extra)

runtime=json.loads((HERE/'runtime-final/result.json').read_text())
runtime_ids=json.loads((HERE/'runtime-final-identities.json').read_text());assert all(sha(ROOT/p)==h for p,h in runtime_ids.items())
assert runtime['native_boot_frames'] and runtime['held_peak_pcm16']>0 and runtime['release_tail_peak_pcm16']==0
assert runtime['process_shutdown']=='clean' and runtime['pull_render']['dropped_frames']==0 and runtime['pull_render']['wav_max_error_pcm16']<1
assert len(runtime['scheduled_midi'])==2

source_names=['native_local.py','native_empty.py','run_cases.py','run_cases_v2.py','probe_base.py','observer.lua','runtime_final.py','analyze.py','patch_sds_local_cleanup_v1.py']

"""Build the experimental OS2.24 local Sample Dump cleanup repair (BUG-122).

Includes BUG-118..121. Consolidate three native UI exit tails and release
the sender flag after parser/display cleanup. No new storage or call frames.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

from patch_sds_sender_guard import (COMMANDS, IMAGE_SIZE, SOURCE_SHA256,
                                    TABLE_OFFSET, long_call,
                                    patches as sender_patches)


def jump(pc,target):
    delta=target-pc-2
    if not -1024<=delta<=1023:raise ValueError('Short jump out of range')
    return bytes((0x20|((delta&0x7FF)>>8),delta&255))


def patches():
    spans=sender_patches()
    common=bytes.fromhex('C7 01 BA 2B 00 B1 08 72 9B 01 76 24 00 DF 61 A1 32 F7 1E')
    common+=long_call(0x9AB3,0xCE62)+jump(0x9AB6,0x9B10)+bytes([0xFD])*4
    second=jump(0x9B0B,0x9AA0)+bytes([0xFD])*3
    second+=bytes.fromhex('B1 FF DA C7 01 AE B1 DA F0')+bytes([0xFD])*14
    third=jump(0x9BA8,0x9AA0)+bytes([0xFD])*26
    before='C7 01 AE B1 00 C7 01 BA 2B 00 B1 08 72 9B 01 76 24 00 DF 07 A1 32 F7 1E EF '
    for offset,pc,tail,after in [(0x5FAA0,0x9AA0,'A7 33 F0',common),
                                (0x5FB0B,0x9B0B,'3C 33 F0',second),
                                (0x5FBA8,0x9BA8,'9F 32 F0',third)]:
        spans.append((offset,pc,bytes.fromhex(before+tail),after))
    return spans

def patch_image(source, output):
    source, output = Path(source).resolve(), Path(output).resolve()
    if source == output:
        raise ValueError('Output must differ from the original image')
    if output.suffix.lower() != '.img':
        raise ValueError('Use an .IMG output filename')
    original = source.read_bytes()
    if len(original) != IMAGE_SIZE or hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() != SOURCE_SHA256:
        raise ValueError('Input must be the original unmodified OS2.24 baseline')
    if original[TABLE_OFFSET:TABLE_OFFSET+8] != COMMANDS:
        raise ValueError('Unexpected SDS command table')
    import pypcode
    ctx = pypcode.Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
    patched = bytearray(original); decoded = []
    for offset, pc, before, after in patches():
        if len(before) != len(after) or original[offset:offset+len(before)] != before:
            raise ValueError(f'Hook byte/length mismatch at {offset:06X}')
        instructions = ctx.disassemble(after, base_address=pc).instructions
        if sum(i.length for i in instructions) != len(after):
            raise ValueError(f'Instruction boundary mismatch at {pc:04X}')
        patched[offset:offset+len(after)] = after
        decoded.append(dict(offset=offset, pc=pc, before=before.hex(), after=after.hex(),
                            instructions=[dict(pc=i.addr.offset, length=i.length, mnemonic=i.mnem, operands=i.body)
                                          for i in instructions]))
    with output.open('xb') as target:
        target.write(patched)
    return dict(source_sha256=SOURCE_SHA256, output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(patched).hexdigest(),
                output=str(output), bytes=len(patched), patches=decoded,
                diff=[dict(offset=i, before=a, after=b) for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(original,patched)) if a!=b],
                limitation='Experimental SDS transfer admission in both directions; local UI exit repair; local/remote overlap, disk exclusion, timeouts, stereo and physical behavior remain unqualified')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--input', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps(patch_image(args.input, args.output), indent=2))

"""Local sender cleanup must release the admission flag after UI cleanup."""
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import pytest

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'scripts'))
from patch_sds_local_cleanup import patches


def image():
    source=ROOT/'roms/System/S760224.IMG'
    if not source.exists():pytest.skip('Requires user-owned OS2.24')
    data=bytearray(source.read_bytes())
    for offset,_,before,after in patches():
        assert data[offset:offset+len(before)]==before
        assert len(before)==len(after)
        data[offset:offset+len(after)]=after
    return data


@pytest.mark.parametrize('entry',[0x9AA0,0x9B0B,0x9BA8])
@pytest.mark.parametrize('controller',[0,1,3])
def test_local_cleanup_releases_sender_after_display(entry,controller):
    data=image();ctx=pytest.importorskip('pypcode').Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
    regs={0:0,0xDA:0xA5};memory={0xB1AE:0,0x2BBA:0,0x2476:controller}
    pc=entry;equal=False;events=[];selector=0x2BE;stack=[];peak=0
    for _ in range(32):
        offset=0x56000+pc
        ins=ctx.disassemble(bytes(data[offset:offset+8]),base_address=pc,max_instructions=1).instructions[0]
        b=data[offset:offset+ins.length];pc+=len(b)
        if b[0]==0xB1:regs[b[2]]=b[1]
        elif b[0]==0xC7:
            address=int.from_bytes(b[2:4],'little')
            if address==0xB1AE:assert selector==0x2BE,'Sender release uses the wrong data bank'
            memory[address]=regs[b[4]]
            events.append((address,memory[address]))
        elif b[0]==0xCB:
            assert b==bytes.fromhex('CB 01 0C 01');stack.append(selector);peak=max(peak,len(stack))
        elif b[0]==0xCF:
            assert b==bytes.fromhex('CF 01 0C 01');selector=stack.pop()
        elif b[0]==0xC3:
            assert b[:4]==bytes.fromhex('C3 01 0C 01');selector=regs[b[4]]
        elif b[0]==0x9B:equal=regs[b[4]]==memory[int.from_bytes(b[2:4],'little')]
        elif b[0]==0xDF:
            if equal:pc+=int.from_bytes(b[1:2],'little',signed=True)
        elif 0x20<=b[0]<=0x27:
            delta=((b[0]&7)<<8)|b[1];pc+=delta-2048 if delta&1024 else delta
        elif b[0]==0xA1:regs[b[3]]=int.from_bytes(b[1:3],'little')
        elif b[0]==0xEF:
            target=(pc+int.from_bytes(b[1:3],'little',signed=True))&65535
            assert target==0xCE62 and regs[0x1E]==0xF732
            assert memory[0xB1AE]==0,'Sender released before display cleanup'
            events.append(('display',target));regs[0xDA]=0x39;selector=0x27C
        elif b[0]==0xF0:break
        else:assert b==bytes([0xFD]),b.hex()
    else:pytest.fail('Cleanup did not terminate')
    assert memory[0xB1AE]==255,'Quiescent local sender still blocks admission'
    assert memory[0x2BBA]==0 and regs[0x72]==8
    assert events[-1]==(0xB1AE,255)
    assert sum(e[0]=='display' for e in events)==(controller!=0)
    assert selector==(0x27C if controller else 0x2BE) and not stack and peak<=1


def test_local_patch_uses_only_existing_cleanup_extents():
    data=image();spans=patches()[-3:]
    assert [(o,p,len(a)) for o,p,_,a in spans]==[(0x5FAA0,0x9AA0,28),(0x5FB0B,0x9B0B,28),(0x5FBA8,0x9BA8,28)]
    ctx=pytest.importorskip('pypcode').Context('MCS96:LE:16:default')
    for _,pc,_,after in spans:
        rows=ctx.disassemble(after,base_address=pc).instructions
        assert sum(i.length for i in rows)==len(after)
        assert not any(i.mnem=='SCALL' for i in rows)
    # The active local cancel path retains its busy flag until common cleanup.
    assert data[0x5FADE:0x5FAE3]==bytes.fromhex('C7 01 AE B1 00')
    assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT/'roms/System/S760224.IMG').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='3827ed4c46fd48abbec3095266164853033141d7bd15afe8dda0050d00e073cd'


def test_build_is_exact_and_does_not_overwrite(tmp_path):
    from patch_sds_local_cleanup import patch_image,IMAGE_SIZE
    source=ROOT/'roms/System/S760224.IMG';output=tmp_path/'local.IMG'
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='differ'):patch_image(source,source)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='.IMG'):patch_image(source,output.with_suffix('.bin'))
    bad=tmp_path/'bad.IMG';bad.write_bytes(bytes(IMAGE_SIZE))
    with pytest.raises(ValueError,match='unmodified'):patch_image(bad,output)
    assert not output.exists()
    report=patch_image(source,output);expected=bytes(image())
    assert output.read_bytes()==expected
    assert report['output_sha256']==hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()
    assert len(report['patches'])==11
    with pytest.raises(FileExistsError):patch_image(source,output)
    assert output.read_bytes()==expected
